DragonScience 使用这些统计判断版本覆盖、文件兼容性和界面使用情况。:
DragonScience uses these statistics to assess version coverage, file compatibility and interface usage.

Included: software version, random installation ID, operating system, system locale (e.g. zh_CN), screen resolution and scaling; format of imported files, instrument model category recognized by the software, success or failure and duration; analysis page visits, exported results and standard error codes; open time and active time per session (cumulative time the window is in the foreground with activity within 2 minutes, recorded in seconds only, no keystrokes or actions are recorded).

Not included: experiment content, calculated values, sample names, file names or paths.

The server receives the connecting IP. Statistics records and IPs are currently retained long-term and used only for version coverage and compatibility statistics. The random installation ID is used to estimate active installations and does not represent actual numbers of people.

You can turn off statistics at any time via “Privacy settings” at the bottom right of the main window. Turning it off clears locally pending records and the installation ID and stops further sending; requests already sent cannot be withdrawn. Analysis features work the same whether it is enabled or not.
